question: A farmer borrowed Rs. 1,32,000 from a money lender to do cultivation in his field. The rate of interest is 12.5% per annum compounded annually. At the end of two years, he cleared his loan by paying Rs. 1,07,062.50 and his scooter. The cost (in Rs.) of the scooter is:

Given:

Borrowed Amount = Rs. 1,32,000

He also gave his scooter as a repayment of the loan.
